title: Tool Parts
subtitle: Frames, cores and upgrades
text:
A tool holds 50k FE and uses 50 FE a block. When empty it is slow and drops nothing.

The body sets the speed: a steel frame digs at 1.25x an iron one.
Overclocker: +50% speed and +50% FE a block, so two give +100% speed at 2x FE.
Energy Cell: +15% speed and +50k FE, no extra FE a block.
The two together add at most +100% speed.

Charge tools in the Charger. FE on NeoForge, Team Reborn Energy on Fabric.
